xmldoc.short_description: Set the position of a graphics object in pixels.

param_input_item.param_description: a scalar graphics object, or the number of a figure. Nothing is done for an empty value.
a real four-element vector [left bottom width height] in pixels.
a logical scalar: false (default) when the position is relative to the parent, true when it is relative to the figure.

description.p: setpixelposition(h, position) sets the Position of h from a position in pixels relative to its parent, the first pixel of the parent being 1. Units of h is kept: Position is stored converted to these units.

setpixelposition(h, position, true) takes a position relative to the figure that holds h: the left and bottom values that getpixelposition(parent, true) reports for the parent container are subtracted first.
For a figure, the position is relative to the screen.
An error is raised for an object that has no four-element Position, such as a line or the root.
